countedBy: lane #190 (opus) from the rectified 2021 panorama w01-273 before the model was rendered. Not a blind haiku count: integrator may re-count. Counted per storey above the puilijst, each window unit (single or paired lights in one frame) as one opening and each recessed glazed strip as one opening; the ground storey is left out (bicycles, car and the hotel entrance block it). Recount after the first comparison (stated, not hidden): on the first floor the recessed strip between planes A and B is its own glazed bay behind a pier, not part of plane A's window wall (10, not 9); plane A's first-floor window wall is centred about 1 m from either window column above it, so it is its own axis under the 0.5 m clustering rule (12 axes, not 11).
